title: Junior Prototype Developer – Customer Projects (f/m/d)
description:
As a development service provider we build functional prototypes for customers in industry and consumer goods.

What you'll do
- Develop and build prototypes using 3D printing
- Direct customer contact in coordination meetings and presentations
- Document the trials

What you bring
- Degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering
- Initial hands-on experience in prototyping
- Fluent, negotiation-ready German for customer conversations
- English skills
